overview: Catalogs go stale when nobody has time to update them. We start with a fixed sprint: we set up a simple routine with you, make the first round of uploads, price and stock changes and fixes, and write down the rules we followed. After that you can keep the routine yourself, or ask us for a quote for monthly care. The sprint price covers the work in the package only.

faq: No. It is a fixed starter sprint with a clear start and end. If you want regular monthly care afterwards, we quote that separately, based on how much work your catalog needs.
How do I send you updates?
Through a shared request sheet or by email. You list what to add or change, and we work through it in each round. We confirm anything unclear before touching live products.
What kinds of tasks fit a sprint?
New arrivals, price and stock updates, seasonal changes, fixing broken images, archiving old items and tidying tags and collections. Large rebuilds are better ordered as a separate project.
